activity.role: U.S. military governor in occupied Bavaria
activity.notes: Following European Nazi defeat, Patton served as military governor in occupied Bavaria as an office of US military occupation. 1945 is a representative source-documented time point, NOT an independent sovereign Bavaria head-of-state reign. US polity only as serving-state association; German occupied administration territorial control metadata unresolved.

sources.title: National WWII Museum — General George S. Patton
sources.citation_text: Museum historian documents Patton at Pershing Mexico 1916, leading 304th Tank Brigade 1918, WWII Western Task Force in North Africa starting 8 November 1942, Sicily Seventh Army 10 July 1943, operational Third Army beginning 1 August 1944, and later Bavarian military governorship after Nazi defeat.

sources.title: United States Army — The 80th Anniversary of Gen. Patton's Final Battle
sources.citation_text: US Army account corroborates 1918 US Tank Corps leadership, service as military governor of Bavaria after WWII, and removal from Third Army command October 1945.
